subject: ready-for-life
standards: Manuel Academy Ready for Life elementary sequence — Grade 3
Ready for Life v1 safety, supervision, and no-shame policy reference
Manuel Academy RFL G3 Unit 6 — family contribution capstone
instructions: Complete the task or its stated simulation alternative. Do not submit photos, recordings, addresses, account details, or private household information.
Learner completion never certifies a guardian-authority task; those tasks remain pending until a guardian attests.

learnerTasks.directions: Before checking anything, look at the space with fresh eyes, as if seeing it for the first time today.
learnerTasks.prompt: Name one thing about the space right now that looks the way you pictured it back on day one.

learnerTasks.directions: With your guardian, go through the finished-loop checklist one item at a time and mark each one together.
learnerTasks.prompt: Every step on the original plan was actually completed, not just started.

learnerTasks.directions: With your guardian, go through the finished-loop checklist one item at a time and mark each one together.
learnerTasks.prompt: Every material used is back in its original spot, not left out.

learnerTasks.directions: With your guardian, go through the finished-loop checklist one item at a time and mark each one together.
learnerTasks.prompt: The space matches what was pictured on day one, or the difference is explained.

learnerTasks.directions: With your guardian, go through the finished-loop checklist one item at a time and mark each one together.
learnerTasks.prompt: Nothing about the job was left half-finished.

learnerTasks.directions: For any checklist item that is not yet complete, finish that specific piece of the job right now, with your guardian present, before the check is finished.
learnerTasks.prompt: If you found an unfinished item, describe exactly what you did to finish it. If everything was already complete, describe how you and your guardian confirmed that together.

learnerTasks.directions: Think about the checking process itself, separate from the job.
learnerTasks.prompt: Describe one checklist item that was easy to check and one that was harder to check, and explain what made the harder one more difficult to judge.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated Checklist thoroughness criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated Completion accuracy criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the assessed objective.
